objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact subject to creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving in the paperless system

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Category of document such as Policy, Guideline, Work Instruction, or Procedural Instruction

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the document in its lifecycle such as editing, released, or archived

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document is considered valid

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date after which the document validity expires

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attached to a main document that is subject to the release cycle of the main document

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the attachment in its lifecycle

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person interacting with the system in various roles

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Position or function assigned to the user such as Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Reader

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned together for authorization and distribution purposes

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category of user group such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Archive

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposed amendment to an existing document managed separately from version history

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the change proposal such as created or completed

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request for reviewing document validity that triggers a workflow

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the validity extension request

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and withdraw it from circulation

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the override request

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated document

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the reactivation request

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined structure for creating new documents of a specific document type

objs.name: signature
objs.description: An electronic signature recorded during workflow completion

attributes.name: participant
attributes.description: The workflow participant who provided the signature

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the signature was applied

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of users and user groups assigned to receive a document

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Method of distribution such as by email or for acknowledgement

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A process for managing document approval and release with multiple steps

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Stage in the workflow such as Creator, Review, or Release

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Reference information linked to documents such as organizational units, risks, or IT applications

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of a new document object with selection of document type and optional template

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modification of document content using the integrated editing client

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Creation or modification of document properties and attributes

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic system conversion of edited document to PDF format

evts.name: initiate_release
evts.description: Start of the workflow-supported 3-step release process by author or co-author

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Completion of a workflow step with electronic signature by a participant

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Workflow step where assigned reviewers check document content for technical and formal aspects

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Workflow step where assigned releasers approve document for distribution to readers

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of document after release making it visible to addressed readers

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Creation of a new version of a released document with automatic status transition to editing

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of a proposed amendment to an existing document by an authorized user

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of a new document version incorporating an approved change proposal

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of an attachment for archiving during document revision

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Workflow-supported confirmation that a document remains valid for an additional period

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System-generated request created 30 days before document validity expires

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declaration of a document as no longer valid and withdrawal from circulation

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Creation of a request to invalidate and archive a document

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdrawal of authorizations for a document making it inaccessible except to archive group

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restoration of a previously invalidated and archived document to valid status

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Creation of a request to re-validate a previously invalidated document

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Notification of assigned users and user groups by email when a new document version is released

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Workflow-supported request for assigned users to actively confirm receipt of a document

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Completion of acknowledgement workflow by a document recipient without signature

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of released document content into another language

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Workflow-supported check of translated document content

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Workflow-supported approval of translated document making it visible to authorized readers

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Addition of an external file or document to a document object

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assignment of read or change permissions to users or user groups for a document
